definitions.explanation: The distance from one bank of a river to the other.

examples.japanese: {川幅|かわはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{川幅|かわはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{狭|せま}く→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Around here the river suddenly narrows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{川幅|かわはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: After the heavy rain the water rose, and the river looked about twice its usual width.

notes:
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) + ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width).
